name: N-t-BOC-MDMA
summary: N-t-BOC-MDMA, also known as N-tert-butoxycarbonyl-MDMA, is a chemical compound which can be both a synthetic precursor to, or a prodrug of the entactogenic drug MDMA ("ecstasy"). It was first identified in Australia in 2015 as a seizure by customs, and has subsequently been found in China, the Netherlands and other European countries.

pharmacology.text: N-t-BOC-MDMA, also known as N-tert-butoxycarbonyl-MDMA, is a chemical compound which can be both a synthetic precursor to, or a prodrug of the entactogenic drug MDMA ("ecstasy").

uses.text: Similar N-protected compounds such as N-t-BOC-methamphetamine, N-p-tosyl-methamphetamine, N-t-BOC-ketamine, N-t-BOC-norketamine, and N-methoxycarbonyl-MDA have also been encountered by law enforcement.

summaryZh: N-t-BOC-MDMA（化學名：N-叔丁氧羰基-3,4-亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C16H23NO4，可作為苯丙胺類興奮劑MDMA（3,4-亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）的前體藥物。
